summary: Enforce the configured company sign-in policy on managed tenant sessions.
userImpact: After a tenant enables company-only sign-in, users must use an enabled company identity provider to enter that organization.
configuration: Enable a company identity provider and verify the administrator's linked identity before disabling other sign-in methods.

changes: Adds a tenant sign-in policy reset for an authorized platform administrator recovery session.

security: Tenant entry and session refresh recheck that company-only sessions still use an enabled company provider.
The recovery endpoint checks platform tenancy management permission and the administrator recovery session and writes an audit event.
knownLimitations: Staging company identity provider and operator recovery acceptance require an actual configured provider.
rollback: Restore the previous compatible host version using the deployment's normal release rollback procedure.
validation: Restricted PostgreSQL tests verified profile linking, one user identity, tenant enforcement, refresh and authorized policy recovery.
